items.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
items.content: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts — Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng — debated regulation, open source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

items.title: Data center demand drives 66% surge in natural gas power plant costs
items.content: Natural gas power plant costs have nearly doubled in two years and take 23% longer to build as data center electricity demand skyrockets.

items.title: Meta makes the Muse filesystem even more accessible
items.content: Yesterday, with a little prodding, it was discovered that Meta's Muse would expose its filesystem to curious users. items.title: Sony and UMG are suing Suno again
items.content: Sony and Universal Music Group filed yet another suit against Suno. The labels claim its new v6 model still infringes on their copyrights because it's trained on user outputs from previous models, which were themselves trained on unlicensed music ripped from YouTube and other sources.
